title: 👗 Google Photos Tests a Feature That Suggests Your Outfits with AI!
body: 👗 Google Photos Tests a Feature That Suggests Your Outfits with AI!

Google is working on a new feature in the Google Photos app called “Build Your Look,” which suggests outfit combinations from your digital wardrobe using AI. The feature was spotted in the latest version of the app on Android, and it may appear inside the current “Closet” section, while the ability to choose clothes manually remains as it is today.
Simply put: the app knows the photos of your clothes, so it suggests ready-made outfits instead of you standing in front of the closet confused every morning.
Would you trust AI’s suggestions for choosing your clothes?
